Package com.nis1.thesis.sdk

Class AlertEnvelopeBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.nis1.thesis.sdk.AlertEnvelopeBuilder
public final class AlertEnvelopeBuilder extends Object
Builds the standard alert envelope every standalone module (SuricataModule, MaltrailModule, Fail2banModule, SysmonModule, ...) publishes to workflow_queue: 
{"message_type": "alert", "event_id": ..., "timestamp": ..., "event_type": ...,
 "source_module": ..., "telemetry": ... (optional), "payload": ...}

Extracted from four independent, duplicated implementations of the same ~15-20 lines - see SDK_USABILITY_AUDIT.md (Abstraction Level / API Elaboration dimensions) for why this existed as copy-pasted boilerplate rather than a shared utility until now.
